nodes.description: Public payable nonReentrant mint entry point; charges _price*_numToMint and refunds excess ETH to msg.sender before minting.
Internal mint loop that picks pseudo-random token ids and safe-mints them to the caller.
Derives a pseudo-random index from msg.sender, block.timestamp, block.number and blockhash and returns an available token id.
Swap-and-pop selection of an available token id from the _availableTokens array.
Owner-only withdrawal splitting the balance between oaf and quack using low-level send.
Owner-only escape hatch forwarding the entire contract balance to msg.sender via call.
Owner-only function that safe-mints 33 tokens to msg.sender.
Owner-only setter for the mint price.
Owner-only function enabling sales.
Owner-only function disabling sales.
View helper computing the mint cost and enforcing supply and per-tx limits.
Builds the metadata URI by concatenating the base URI, token id and .json suffix.
Public boolean gating the mint function.
Private mint price in wei (0.02021 ether), owner-settable.
Counter of still-available token ids, decremented on each selection.
Fixed size array storing available token id indices used for the randomization swap trick.
Hardcoded payout address used by withdrawTeam.
Hardcoded payout address used by withdrawTeam.
Private base metadata URI used by _baseURI/tokenURI.
Public flag recording that the sale was ever started.
Constant upper bound of tokens mintable in a single transaction.
Caller-controlled address used for refunds, minting and withdrawal targets.
Miner-influenced timestamp mixed into the pseudo-random token id derivation.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(msg.value - cost) executed inside mint before the minting state effects.

Pseudo-random number derived from publicly known / miner-influenceable values.
_price * _numToMint multiplication computing the required payment.

Number of tokens being fetched in the current mint batch, mixed into the randomness.

Index selected from the available-token pool.

Token id argument of tokenURI.
Local storing _price * _numToMint in mint.

edges.reason: mint reads the untrusted msg.sender to determine the refund recipient.
mint forwards excess ETH to msg.sender via transfer before performing the minting state updates.
mint requires isSaleOn to be true before proceeding.
mint reads _price to compute the required payment.
Payment computed as _price * _numToMint, an unchecked multiplication opportunity.
Caller-controlled _numToMint drives the mint amount and payment.
totalSupply() result is used for the maximum supply check.
mint delegates the actual minting to the internal _mint function.
_mint requires _numToMint <= MAX_MINTABLE_AT_ONCE.
_mint decrements _numAvailableTokens after each mint.
_mint stores the selected token id in newTokenId.
_mint calls useRandomAvailableToken for each token.
_safeMint triggers onERC721Received on the recipient contract, an external callback.
Token id derived from a keccak256 hash of miner-influenceable values.
msg.sender is mixed into the randomness input.
block.timestamp is used as a randomness source, creating timestamp dependency.
_numAvailableTokens is used as the modulo bound for randomIndex.
randomIndex = randomNum % _numAvailableTokens, an unchecked modulo.
useRandomAvailableToken forwards the index to useAvailableTokenAtIndex.
_numToFetch is hashed into the random seed.
_i is hashed into the random seed.
useAvailableTokenAtIndex reads and writes _availableTokens for the swap-and-pop.
_numAvailableTokens is decremented without bounds protection.
indexToUse selects the slot consumed from the pool.
valAtIndex caches _availableTokens[indexToUse].
withdrawTeam pushes balance to oaf and quack with low-level send.
withdrawTeam is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdrawTeam reads the oaf payout address.
withdrawTeam reads the quack payout address.
_balance caches address(this).balance for the split.
withdrawFailsafe performs an unrestricted value call to msg.sender with the full balance.
withdrawFailsafe is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
Officialcasting safe-mints 33 tokens, invoking recipient callbacks.
Officialcasting uses totalSupply() to compute the new token ids.
setPrice consumes the _newPrice parameter.
setPrice is an owner-only writer of the _price state variable.
startSale writes isSaleOn = true.
startSale writes saleHasBeenStarted = true.
startSale is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
endSale writes isSaleOn = false.
getCostForMintingPunks returns _numToMint * _price.
getCostForMintingPunks requires _numToMint <= MAX_MINTABLE_AT_ONCE.
tokenURI reads _baseTokenURI through _baseURI.
tokenURI uses the _tokenId parameter for the metadata path.

Cached supply total used for the supply cap check inside mint.

Intermediate modulo result of the randomness derivation.
